description: Slotted mode waits (NODE_SLOT_POSITION - 1) slots when the last transmission was not this node's, makes no PRNG draw, and a run-time change to jitter makes the next round draw.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). The S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, U_PDU "hello"; it asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095), and it is data queued for transmission (K-0096). Position 3 of 4 slots of 3000 ms: (3 - 1) x 3000 = 6000 ms (K-0081). The node has not transmitted, so the last transmission is never its own (K-0086). Slotted mode never draws, so after the change to jitter at 66000 the first csma.jitter draw of seed 0 is made: uniform(4) for seed 0 is 3 (0xe220a8397b1dcdaf mod 4), 9000 ms. A changed csma.mode applies to the next contention computation (core-architecture.md 7.3).
